newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe police use teargas to break demonstration.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe police use teargas to break demonstration.

text.p: Zimbabwean riot police on Monday fired teargas and used batons to break up a demonstration called by trade unions, churches and human rights groups in support of striking nurses and doctors.
Witnesses said dozens of police moved against some 200 people who were gathering for a planned march into the city centre later in the day.
They said the police also arrested two union leaders -- Morgan Tsvangirayi and Isaac Matongo -- secretary-general and vice-president of the Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions (ZCTU).
"The police pounced, firing teargas, beating people and the crowd dispersed," one witness said.
